skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles and bases for calculating social insurance fees.
Understand and apply methods for determining social insurance fees for short-term and long-term benefits and factors affecting the choice of financial mechanisms.
Understand the necessity and role of social insurance supervision, including the basis, objects, and procedures for supervision and handling violations.
Understand the social insurance policy, the policy cycle, and analyze and evaluate the stages of the policy cycle.
Understand the necessity, objects, and scope of health insurance and unemployment insurance, and calculate benefits in various scenarios.
Develop independent thinking, critical thinking, and the ability to work in groups and inspire others.
Analyze and evaluate the provisions, strengths, and weaknesses of social insurance policies.
Develop the ability to conduct independent research, write reports, and present findings.
Understand legal compliance and responsibilities towards society.
